description: This source file defines classes related to stream queue mapping in Orleans, specifically implementing hash ring-based distribution strategies. It includes HashRingBasedStreamQueueMapper for balancing queues using a hash ring, and HashRingBasedPartitionedStreamQueueMapper for mapping partitions to queue identifiers.

classes.name: HashRingBasedStreamQueueMapper
classes.description: Implements a stream queue mapper that uses a hash ring to distribute queues among silos, balancing load and providing consistent hashing.

classes.name: HashRingBasedPartitionedStreamQueueMapper
classes.description: Extends HashRingBasedStreamQueueMapper to map specific partitions (identified by their IDs) to QueueIds, allowing partition-aware queue assignment.

methods.name: GetQueuesForRange
methods.description: Returns all QueueIds whose hash values fall within the specified range.

methods.name: GetAllQueues
methods.description: Returns all QueueIds managed by the hash ring.

methods.name: GetQueueForStream
methods.description: Calculates and returns the QueueId responsible for a given stream ID based on hash.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the hash ring.

methods.name: QueueToPartition
methods.description: Retrieves the partition ID associated with a given QueueId.
